title: Weekly ODNI briefings for national-security reporters (Mockingbird)

tellings.quote: They they go to places like OD and I on a weekly basis and get their briefing for what they're going to talk about next week.

plain: National-security reporters go every week to the ODNI, the office that oversees all the US intelligence agencies, to be briefed on what they will be talking about the following week. That is the claim of Matthew Brown, presented on the show as a Pentagon whistleblower, who says he knows it first-hand. He offers it as an example of what the story calls Mockingbird, a name for the idea that intelligence agencies steer the press. If true, it would mean that what the public reads on these subjects is shaped in advance.
